text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road gave it everything she 
had, but victory slipped through her 
fingers. And she was made to realize the 
harsh reality once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor was T.M. Opera O. Faced with 
her running and an indescribable aura of 
dread, Narita Top Road was genuinely 
terrified.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing she couldn't leave her unchecked 
like this, Admire Vega resolved to defeat 
TM Opera O at the "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing this, Narita Top Road also decided 
to enter— but as things stood, her chances 
of winning were slim. She urgently needed 
to find a way to face the challenge.
